youtube.baslik: How long is the wavelength of the lowest sound we can hear? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In air at 20 degrees Celsius, a 20 Hz sound has a wavelength of about 17 meters, the height of a building, while a 20,000 Hz sound has a wavelength of about 1.7 centimeters. Wavelength determines how sound interacts with obstacles and with our body: low sounds bend around obstacles, and the head blocks high sounds.
